columns.name: EVENT_POOL_MEMBER_ID
columns.description: The primary key of the table and also foreign Key to HRT_POOL_MEMBERS.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_LANGUAGE_CODE
columns.description: This column will store the language of site while registering for the event.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IRC_REC_EVENTS_B

columns.name: DISQUALIFIED_FLAG
columns.description: To track if candidate was disqualified (aggregate snapshot of DQ answers).

columns.name: QSTNR_SCORE
columns.description: The total questionnaire score for this candidate registration.

columns.name: HRT_POOL_ID
columns.description: This column stores the event pool id. Foreign key to HRT_POOLS_B table.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: This column stores the event person id.Foreign key to PER_PERSONS table.

columns.name: CURRENT_PHASE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IRC_PHASES_B table.

columns.name: CURRENT_STATE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IRC_STATES_B table.

columns.name: PROCESS_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IRC_PROCESSES_B table.

columns.name: PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IRC_PROCESSES_B table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REGISTERED_DATE
columns.description: The date in which the pool member registers for this event.

columns.name: CONFIRMED_DATE
columns.description: Date in which the registration is confirmed

columns.name: CONFIRMED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to show if event registration is confirmed

columns.name: AF_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IRC_AF_VERSIONS.AF_VERSION_ID.

columns.name: LEGAL_DESC_VERSION_ID
columns.description: To track the legal disclaimer accepted by the applicant. Foreign key to IRC_DESC_VERSIONS_B.DESC_VERSION_ID.

columns.name: SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: unique identifier of the site from which the registration of event was done.

columns.name: OBJECT_STATUS
columns.description: indicates the status of the record.for soft deleted records value will be ORA_DELETED
